title: Quantization Bridge: Validation Sentinel for FP8/INT8 Profiles
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Build an automated validation sentinel that sits between the calibration pipeline and rollout orchestration to enforce accuracy gates for FP8 and INT8 model variants. The sentinel (codenamed "Quant-Bridge") will run an end-to-end validation harness using curated golden prompts, adversarial perturbations, and a blend of semantic and token-level metrics. It should produce deterministic pass/fail signals, detailed failure fingerprints, and a suggested rollback/tuning action for the deployment layer. Goal: reduce manual review time for quant rollouts and prevent regressions that escape existing unit and smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel runs as a CI job and returns a structured pass/fail artifact for each candidate quant profile
Validation covers at least 1,200 golden prompts across conversational, instructions, and code-completion categories

Primary metrics (BERTScore, perplexity delta, exact-match on curated keys) computed per-prompt and aggregated; pass if less than 2.5% of prompts exceed metric deltas and 95th-percentile latency budget is met
Adversarial perturbation set (10 variants per prompt) exercised and failures attributable to quantization (not prompt ambiguity) reported
Failure artifacts include top-k divergent token traces, KV-cache sensitivity score, layer-sensitivity heatmap link, and reproducible replay ID
Pipeline hooks created for runtime-1.20 rollouts: canary blocking, manual override with justification, and automatic fallback to float32 replica on high-severity failures
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Define goldens and adversarial generator + build runner that replays requests against float32 baseline and quant candidate
Phase 2: Metric computation service that emits BERTScore, token-level edit-distance, perplexity delta, and a custom semantic-drift score
Phase 3: Threshold and gate logic with paired statistical test (bootstrap paired differences) to avoid false positives on small samples
Phase 4: Integrate with CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and Redwood rollouts to block canaries when gate fails
Phase 5: Add telemetry dashboards and run an initial sweep against internal model catalog (3 models x 4 sequence-length bands x two quant profiles)
Phase 6: Iteration based on pilot feedback and cadence to add new golden families
tradeoffs_considered: Stricter thresholds reduce regression risk but increase false blocks, slowing rollouts. We considered (A) conservative fixed thresholds, (B) per-model adaptive thresholds calibrated on pre-release baselines, and (C) contextual thresholds that vary by prompt family. Chosen approach: per-model adaptive thresholds with a minimum floor to avoid drift absorption. Also considered cost: full-run harness for every PR is expensive; we will run a fast smoke subset on PRs and the full harness nightly for candidates.
runbook: If sentinel fails during CI: collect failure artifact ID and link to replay job; triage by running single-prompt replay locally with float32 vs quant candidate
For production blocking failure: open incident, set rollout to fallback float32 pool, notify owners and pause further canaries
If failures concentrated on specific prompt family: mark family as blocked and create follow-up ticket to expand golden set and adjust calibration strategy
If statistical test is inconclusive: increase sample size (add 2x perturbations) and re-run; only block if adjusted p-value < 0.05 and effect size exceeds minimum delta

notes: We observed a reproducible token-level deviation pattern when KV-cache reordering interacts with int8 matmul kernels on older GPU drivers. Driver variance will be noted in the artifact so that rollout decisions for Dedicated customers can be region-aware.
rollout_plan: 1) PR-level smoke runner (subset of 120 golden prompts, fast metrics) -> non-blocking and comment results on PR
2) Candidate snapshot (full harness, 1,200 prompts + perturbations) -> produce pass/fail artifact stored in artifact store
3) Canary rollout blocked if sentinel FAILS; require manual override with root-cause and mitigation plan
4) If minor regressions (<=0.5% prompts exceed delta) and not CPU/GPU-driver-specific, allow staged canary with additional monitoring
5) Automatic rollback to float32 if production error budget exceeded within 1 hour of canary start
test_matrix_summary: Prompt families: conversational, instruction-following, code-completion, tabular-extraction
Perturbations: typo, whitespace noise, role-prefix injection, trailing-punctuation, adversarial context swap
golden_set_statistics: 1,200 canonical prompts across 4 families; expanded perturbations produce ~13,200 candidate runs per profile; baseline acceptance threshold computed from 10 historical float32 runs to estimate natural variance. Current per-profile artifact size ~ 2.4GB compressed.
implementation_risks: High compute cost for full-harness runs; mitigated by nightlies and PR-level smoke subset
False-positives from metric sensitivity to paraphrase; mitigated by using semantic metrics + paired bootstrap rather than raw delta thresholds
Driver and hardware-specific failures that are not related to quant math; include driver fingerprint in artifacts to allow targeted exclusions
